def factor_drawdown_depth_atr_short_window(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    peak = df_copy["close"].rolling(21, min_periods=21).max()
    dd = (df_copy["close"] - peak) / peak
    depth = -dd
    atr_21 = pd.Series(talib.ATR(df_copy['high'].values.astype(np.float64), df_copy['low'].values.astype(np.float64), df_copy['close'].values.astype(np.float64), timeperiod=21), index=df_copy.index)
    factor = depth / atr_21.replace(0, np.nan)
    factor = factor.fillna(0)
    df_copy["factor_drawdown_depth_atr_short_window"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_drawdown_depth_atr_short_window"]
